messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — consolidating actions for streaming/chat endpoint reliability (timeouts, partials, reconnects). I'll list owners & provisional deadlines. Please ack or update.

ops-bot: Incident link: <https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-204|INC-2026-204> — sev2. Timeline & logs attached in the incident doc.

maria: I'll take A1 — client handshake/backoff tuning. Plan: adjust default backoff, add jitter, add integration test. Target: EOD Thu 2026-03-26. @alex can you add test cases?

alex: Yep, will add 2 prompts to the regression harness and a load test scenario.

jin: I'll own A2 — server-side reconnect state cleanup & idempotency. Need a 2d spike to decide whether to store ephemeral connect IDs in redis. Tentative completion: Mon 2026-03-30.

sam: I can do A3 — observability & alerts: metric for 'partial_response_rate' and a dashboard. Also add an alert when partials > 1% for 5m. ETA Tue 2026-03-24.

maria: Pushing a config snippet for the proposed retry window changes:
```
retry:
  max_attempts: 3
  backoff_ms: 200
  jitter: true
  handshake_timeout_ms: 12000
```

jin: For reconnect logic, let's be careful with KV-cache invalidation. If we force a reconnect too aggressively we can thrash the cache. Proposal: exponential backoff + server-side marker to skip cache flush for 1 retry.

sam: Agreed. I'll add logs for 'reconnect_reason' and a label for 'cache_preserved' so we can filter.

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: canary-deploy/streaming-retry-window — requested by alex. Ops approval needed: @ops.

alex: Can ops please approve canary for 1h at 10% traffic? If no errors, roll to 50%.

ops-bot: @ops notified. ETA 03:00 UTC. Canary window will be monitored automatically.

maria: Adding a small e2e test for partials: simulate truncated responses + reconnects. Example assertion: client receives either full stream or explicit reconnect event within 5s.

alex: Also adding a post-deploy smoke job that checks for increased 'partial_response' or 'handshake_timeout' spikes.

jin: Quick log example from last incident:
```
[streaming] WARN PartialResponseDetector: 12 partials in 5m from model-x
[runtime] ERROR HandshakeTimeout: conn_id=abc123 elapsed=13500ms
```

sam: Action items summary (putting on the board):
- A1: client backoff tuning — owner: maria — due: 2026-03-26
- A2: reconnect state cleanup — owner: jin — due: 2026-03-30
- A3: observability & alerts — owner: sam — due: 2026-03-24
- A4: canary + rollback policy — owner: alex + ops — canary: 10% 1h

maria: I'll PR the backoff change and add the e2e; request review from jin.

jin: I'll review and start the spike. If we need to prototype redis marker I'll ping infra for short-lived instance.

alex: Thanks all. I'll schedule a 15m sync on Mon to check progress, and keep the incident doc updated. Any blockers post here or DM.

sam: :thumbsup:

maria: ack

jin: ack
